captions.detailed: An artisan-style stand mixer featuring a beige pedestal base with a broad rectangular foot and an integrated vertical column. A metallic-gray mixing bowl is supported on a short front carriage, while a rounded beige tilt head sits directly above the bowl. The mixer includes functional articulations: the bowl rides on a small prismatic slide relative to the base, the main head tilts upward on a rear horizontal revolute joint, a whisk attachment spins continuously on a vertical drive beneath the head, a side speed lever on the base rotates on a small pivot, and a head-lock button translates on a short prismatic stroke.
captions.instruction: Generate an artisan-style stand mixer with a beige base and tilt head, a metallic-gray mixing bowl, and an attached whisk. The assembly must include five articulations: a prismatic joint for the bowl carriage, a revolute joint for the tilt head, a continuous joint for the spinning whisk, a revolute joint for the side speed lever, and a prismatic joint for the head-lock button.
captions.factory: Construct the base part using a flat box for the foot, a lofted or extruded column, and a rear hinge mount. Create the bowl carriage as a separate sliding part using a small box, and model the bowl as a hollowed revolved shell. Build the tilt head using a rounded box or lofted profile, attaching a rear hinge pin. Define the whisk as a wireframe-like continuous spinning assembly, and add the speed lever and lock button as small cylinders/boxes with corresponding revolute and prismatic joints.
